y-m-03-01.title: Mutsara Mumwe Wemabhatani, Maboka Akasiyana Emabhatani Makuru
y-m-03-01.topic: Zviyero zvekurongedza: kusarudza mashoko anopa mhedzisiro imwe chete kuvanhu vose
y-m-03-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kurongedza neshoko seye 'rakakura,' rine muganhu usina kujeka, kunogona kupa mhedzisiro dzakasiyana kuvanhu vakasiyana, uye gadzira uye utaure muyero unopa mhedzisiro imwe chete pasinei nekuti ndiani anorongedza.
y-m-03-01.material:
Mabhatani 8 akarongwa mumutsara mumwe kubva padiki zvikuru kusvika pakuru zvikuru. Kubva kuruboshwe anodaidzwa 가, 나, 다, 라, 마, 바, 사, ne 아. Mabhatani ose ane ruvara nechimiro chimwe chete uye anosiyana muhukuru chete.
Mina akaunganidza 라, 마, 바, 사, ne 아 (mabhatani 5) se 'mabhatani makuru'. Hajun akaunganidza 마, 바, 사, ne 아 (mabhatani 4) se 'mabhatani makuru'. Vaviri vakatarisa mutsara mumwe chete wemabhatani, uye vose vakarongedza neshoko re 'bhatani rakakura'.

y-m-03-01.thinking.2: Gadzira muyero wekurongedza wakajeka iwe pachako
y-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chakakodzera zvikuru chekuti mabhatani makuru akaunganidzwa nevanhu vaviri akasiyana?
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora padivi nedivi mabhatani makuru akaunganidzwa nevanhu vaviri, uye utsvage kuti mabhatani api akasiyana.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana wotora bhatani iroro kuriisa mu 'mabhatani makuru' kana kwete, uye kana ndiwe waitonga, ungatarisa chii kusarudza.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.a: Mina ane maziso akanaka kupfuura Hajun, saka kuunganidza kwaMina kwakarurama zvikuru
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakazvitora semubvunzo wemaziso akanaka kana asina kunaka. Vanhu vose vaviri vakatarisa mutsara mumwe chete ndokuunganidza vachishandisa shoko re 'rakakura,' saka musiyano waiva pamuganhu weshoko.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.b: Vakaverenga nhamba zvisiri izvo, saka kana vakaverenga zvakare mhedzisiro dzevanhu vaviri dzichafanana
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakazvitora sekukanganisa kuverenga. Musiyano pakati pe5 ne4 ungava nokuda kwekukanganisa kuverenga, asi ungavawo nokuti vakasiyana pavanotanga kudaidza bhatani kuti 'bhatani rakakura'.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.c: Hajun aisaziva zvinoreva 'rakakura,' saka Hajun chete akaipa uye Mina akarurama
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakazvitora sekuti munhu mumwe chete akaipa. Vanhu vose vaviri vakaunganidza zvakakodzera nemuyero wavo wega.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.d: Haisarudzwi neshoko roga kuti bhatani rakakura rinotanga papi, saka vakadhirowa muganhu zvakasiyana
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakatarisa pane shoko re 'rakakura' rinopatsanura. Uku kufunga kwakaongorora muganhu weshoko rinova muyero.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.explain: Neshoko seye 'rakakura' roga, apo vanhu vanogona kudhirowa muganhu zvakasiyana, zvakaoma kuwana mhedzisiro imwe chete. Mina akaona mabhatani kubva ku 라 zvichienda mberi se 'mabhatani makuru,' uye Hajun akaona mabhatani kubva ku 마 zvichienda mberi se 'makuru'. Vose vakarongedza zvakakodzera nemuyero wavo.

y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.a: Ita kuti vanhu vaviri vasarudze nenzira imwe chete kuti bhatani ripi rinotanga kuverengwa se 'bhatani rakakura'
y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakatarisa pane mutsetse unopatsanura. Wakasarudza zvinodiwa kuita muyero kuva mumwe chete.

y-m-03-02.title: Ndakapatsanura mumabhokisi maviri, asi makadhi akawedzera
y-m-03-02.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kana mazita emabhokisi akarongedzwa achiyambukirana kana mamwe makadhi asina bhokisi, mhedzisiro yakaverengwa inogona kusiyana nehuwandu hwose, uye gadzirisa kurongedza kuti kadhi rega rega rimbopinda panzvimbo imwe chete.
y-m-03-02.material:
Pane makadhi 9 muhuwandu. Mazita emakadhi nehuwandu hwemakadhi ndezvinotevera.
[Makadhi] Denderedzwa tsvuku makadhi 3 / Denderedzwa blue makadhi 2 / Triangle tsvuku makadhi 2 / Triangle blue makadhi 2 (huwandu makadhi 9)
Seoa akagadzira mabhokisi maviri. Rimwe i 'bhokisi remakadhi matsvuku' uye rimwe i 'bhokisi remakadhi edenderedzwa'. Akatarisa makadhi rimwe nerimwe ndokuisa kadhi rega rega rinokodzera bhokisi mubhokisi iroro. Makadhi asina kukodzera bhokisi rimwe chete akasiiwa patafura.

Saka 10, huwandu hwe5 ne5, haisi huwandu hwemakadhi. Mutsara 4: kuwedzera kwe10 yakaverengwa mumabhokisi ndekwekuti makadhi mamwe chete akaverengwa kaviri. Haisi nokuti makadhi 9 akaverengwa pakutanga akaipa. Mutsara 5: matriangle blue 2 haagoni kupinda mubhokisi ripi zvaro, saka akasara patafura. Saka 'pasina akasiiwa' hazvirurami futi. y-m-03-04.title: Ndingaratidza sei munin'ina asingagoni kuverenga nhamba?
y-m-03-04.topic: Kuratidza data imwe chete netafura nemufananidzo wemadenderedzwa
y-m-03-04.goal: Nzwisisa kuti data imwe chete inogona kuratidzwa netafura nemufananidzo wemadenderedzwa, enzanisa kuti chii chinokodzera muverengi ipi, uye unyore mashoko anotsanangura kumunin'ina.
y-m-03-04.material:
Takaongorora zvaunodiwa zvemwaka wevadzidzi 12 mukirasi yedu. Munhu mumwe nemumwe akasarudza mwaka mumwe chete.
[Tafura] Chirimo vadzidzi 4 / Zhizha vadzidzi 5 / Zhizha rekupedzisira mudzidzi 1 / Chando vadzidzi 2 (vadzidzi 12 zvose)
Takaratidzawo data imwe chete semufananidzo wemadenderedzwa. Pasi pezita remwaka mumwe nemumwe, madenderedzwa (○) akaiswa kumusoro akawanda sehuwandu hweshamwari dzakaisarudza. Chirimo chine madenderedzwa 4 akaunganidzwa, zhizha 5, zhizha rekupedzisira 1, uye chando 2.

y-m-03-04.thinking.2: Kushandura zvaunogona kuziva kubva pamufananidzo kuita mashoko
y-m-03-04.s.s1.prompt: Kuudza munin'ina asati agona kuverenga nhamba mwaka upi uri mukuru, chii chakanakisa?
y-m-03-04.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa zvaunofanira kutarisa mutafura nemumufananidzo kuti utsvage mwaka une vakawanda.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.o.a: Nongedza mwaka apo madenderedzwa akaunganidzwa kumusoro zvakanyanya
y-m-03-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti unogona kuenzanisa kukwira nemaziso kunyangwe usingazivi nhamba. Wakasarudza nzira inokodzera anogamuchira.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kunyora nhamba hombe. Kana munin'ina asati agona kuverenga nhamba, zvakaoma kuverenga kunyangwe dziri hombe.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.o.c: Ratidza tafura uye uverenge nhamba zvinonzwika
y-m-03-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuverenga zvinonzwika. Anogona kuziva nekunzwa, asi zvingaoma kuti munin'ina aenzanise ega.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.o.d: Taura chete kuti pane vadzidzi 12 zvose
y-m-03-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kutaura huwandu hwose chete. Huwandu hwose hahukuudzi musiyano pakati pemwaka.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.explain: Mufananidzo wemadenderedzwa unogona kuenzaniswa nekukwira kunyangwe usingagoni kuverenga nhamba. Kuverenga nhamba kubva patafura kunogonawo kuva nzira yekuudza munin'ina, asi mufananidzo unonyatsoita nyore kuti munin'ina aenzanise ega.
y-m-03-04.s.s1.acc.0: Kana ukaverenga nhamba zvinonzwika, munin'ina anogona kuzvinzwa kunyangwe asingagoni kuverenga nhamba. Asi mukuru ndiye aizoita kuenzanisa. Munyaya iyi, mufananidzo unonyatsoita nyore kana uchida kuti vaenzanise ivo pachavo.

y-m-03-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti unofanira kuita chii kuti utsvage nhamba chaiyo mumufananidzo wemadenderedzwa.

y-m-03-04.s.s2.r.a: Wakafunga nezvekana mabhokisi ashoma. Kana mabhokisi ashoma, mufananidzo unoonekwa nyore zvakanyanya.
y-m-03-04.s.s2.o.b: Kana uchitsvaga mwaka une vakawanda pakutarisa kamwe uchienzanisa
y-m-03-04.s.s2.r.b: Wakafunga kuenzanisa kukwira nemaziso. Mufananidzo wemadenderedzwa unonyatsoita basa rakadai.
y-m-03-04.s.s2.r.c: Wakatarisa poinzi yekuti madenderedzwa ose anofanira kudhirowa. Kana nhamba iri hombe zvikuru, zvakaoma kudhirowa uye kuverenga.
y-m-03-04.s.s2.o.d: Kana unofanira kunyora nhamba chaiyo senhamba
y-m-03-04.s.s2.r.d: Wakatarisa kunyora nhamba chaiyo. Mutafura, nhamba inonyorwa zvakananga senhamba.
y-m-03-04.s.s2.explain: Mufananidzo wemadenderedzwa wakanaka kuenzanisa zvakawanda nezvishoma pakutarisa kamwe, asi kana nhamba iri hombe zvikuru zvakaoma kudhirowa, uye unofanira kuverenga kuti uzive nhamba chaiyo. Tafura inogona kunyora nhamba chaiyo zvakananga.
y-m-03-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mashoko anoratidza munin'ina mufananidzo wemadenderedzwa uye ouudza kuti mwaka upi uri mukuru. Nyorawo kuti anogona kuziva sei kubva pamufananidzo.

y-m-03-06.title: Kana mutsara murefu, pane makadhi akawanda here?
y-m-03-06.topic: Kuenzanisa nhamba: hurefu hwemutsara nenhamba zvakafanana here?
y-m-03-06.goal: Nzwisisa kuti haugoni kutaura kuti pane akawanda nekuti mutsara murefu, uye utaure nzira dzekuenzanisa nhamba nekuita mapeya rimwe rimwe kana kuverenga, uye kuenzanisa nehurefu kunobvumirwa rini.
y-m-03-06.material:
Minseo akaisa makadhi emadenderedzwa ose ehukuru hwakafanana mumitsara miviri. Mumutsara wepamusoro akaparadzira makadhi kure, uye mumutsara wepasi akaisa makadhi akabatana. Nemaziso, mutsara wepamusoro murefu kupfuura wepasi. Haasati averenga makadhi.
Seohyeon akati, "Mutsara wepamusoro murefu, saka mutsara wepamusoro une makadhi akawanda!"
y-m-03-06.thinking.0: Funga kuti kutonga kwekutanga kune chikonzero here
y-m-03-06.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa akawanda neashoma nekuenzanisa rimwe nerimwe
y-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga tarisa kuti mikaha iri pakati pemakadhi emutsara wepamusoro newepasi yakafanana here kana yakasiyana.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa nyaya apo hurefu hwemutsara hunogona kusiyana kunyangwe nehuwandu hwakafanana hwemakadhi.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama. Kana mutsara murefu, une makadhi akawanda
y-m-03-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandura hurefu hwemutsara kuita huwandu hwemakadhi. Kana ukaparadzira makadhi kure, mutsara unogona kuva murefu kunyangwe ine makadhi mashoma.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.o.b: Mutsara wepasi wakabatana, saka mutsara wepasi une makadhi akawanda
y-m-03-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakatonga nekungotarisa chimiro chekuva padhuze. Haugoni kutaura kuti pane makadhi akawanda nekuti akabatana.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakatonga kuti akafanana, asi hausati waverenga. Unoda chikonzero chekutaura kuti akafanana.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.o.d: Haugoni kusarudza kuti mutsara upi une akawanda nehurefu oga
y-m-03-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga hurefu hwaunoona nehuwandu hwemakadhi zvakaparadzana. Wakacherekedza kuti nzira isiri hurefu inodiwa.
y-m-03-06.s.s1.explain: Kana mikaha iri pakati pemakadhi yakafara, mutsara unoita murefu kunyangwe ine makadhi mashoma. Hurefu hwemutsara oga hahugoni kusarudza kuti divi ripi rine makadhi akawanda. Unofanira kuaverenga kana kuaita mapeya rimwe rimwe.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.prompt: Seohyeon akaita mapeya emakadhi emutsara wepamusoro newepasi rimwe rimwe uye akaabatanidza nemitsetse. Kadhi rega rega remutsara wepamusoro rakawana mumwe wekuita naye peya, uye makadhi 2 asina mumwe wekuita naye peya akasara mumutsara wepasi. Mutsara upi une makadhi akawanda?
y-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ratidza zvakaparadzana makadhi ane mumwe wekuita naye peya nemakadhi asina mumwe wekuita naye peya mumutsara wepamusoro newepasi.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.1: Taura kuti makadhi asina mumwe wekuita naye peya ari mumutsara upi.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.r.a: Wakaenderera nekufungidzira kwekutanga kwokuti mutsetse mutsetse murefu. Tarisazve kuti mutsetse upi une makadhi asara kana akaitwa peya.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.r.b: Wakatarisa rutivi rune makadhi asara mukuita peya. Wakatonga zvakawanda nezvishoma nemhedzisiro yekuenzanisa rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.r.c: Wakashaya ruzivo rwokuti makadhi asina peya akasara. Kana pane makadhi asara, haana huwandu hwakafanana.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.r.d: Hauna kuvimba nekuita peya senzira yekuenzanisa. Rutivi rune makadhi asara pasina peya rune akawanda.
y-m-03-06.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaita peya rimwe nerimwe, mutsetse une makadhi asara pasina peya une makadhi akawanda. Kuita peya kunogona kushandiswa kunyange mutsetse murefu kana mupfupi.

y-m-03-09.goal: Funga nyaya dzakati wandei kuona kuti kana musiyano kubva pazvakawanda zvakanyanya uri mudiki, sarudzo yemunhu mumwe inogona kushandura mhedzisiro, uye kana uchizivisa mhedzisiro, taura saizi yemusiyano pamwe chete.
y-m-03-09.material:
Vadzidzi 14 muboka mumwe nomumwe akasarudza chinhu chimwe chaanoda kuita panguva yekuzorora.
[Tafura] Kuverenga vadzidzi 6 / Kudhirowa vadzidzi 5 / Puzzle vadzidzi 3 (huwandu hwose vadzidzi 14)
Zvino kuverenga ndiko kune vakawanda zvakanyanya woga. Asi shamwari imwe inoti ichashandura pfungwa ichisarudza chimwe chinhu. Shamwari imwe chete ndiyo inoshandura pfungwa, uye inoda kusarudza chinhu chakasiyana nechaakasarudza pakutanga.

y-m-03-09.thinking.2: Sarudza chirevo chakakodzera kana musiyano uri mudiki

y-m-03-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora maviri ese echaakasarudza pakutanga munhu anogona kushandura pfungwa nechaasarudza nyowani.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kune peya yega yega, nyora rimwe nerimwe kuti nhamba dzekuverenga, kudhirowa, nepuzzle dzinova dzei.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.o.a: Kuverenga kune vadzidzi 6, ivo vakawanda, saka hakungashandurwi munyaya ipi neipi
y-m-03-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti vadzidzi 6 vakawanda chete. Hauna kutarisa kuti nhamba dzinova dzei kana imwe yabviswa kana imwe yawedzerwa kune imwe.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.o.b: Inogona kushanduka kana kusashanduka zvichienderana nokuti ndiani anoshandura uye kuenda kupi
y-m-03-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa poindi yokuti mhedzisiro inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nokuti ndiani anoshandura uye chaanosarudza nyowani. Kutonga uku kunofunga munyaya dzakasiyana.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.o.c: Kana munhu mumwe akashandura pfungwa, mhedzisiro inogara ichishanduka munyaya dzese
y-m-03-09.s.s1.r.c: Wakasarudza kuti nyaya dzese dzinoshanduka. Kana shanduko yakaitwa kumwe kusina chekuita nekuverenga, inogona kuramba yakafanana.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.o.d: Hatizivi kuti ndiani anoshandura, saka hatigoni kufunga kuti chii chichaitika
y-m-03-09.s.s1.r.d: Wakamira kufunga nokuti pane chausingazivi. Unogona kupatsanura nyaya dzese dzinogoneka uye uzvifunge.
y-m-03-09.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga (vadzidzi 6) nekudhirowa (vadzidzi 5) zvinosiyana ne mudzidzi 1. Kana imwe ikabviswa kubva pakuverenga kana imwe ikawedzerwa kukudhirowa, mhedzisiro inoshanduka, uye kana shanduko yakaitwa kurutivi rwepuzzle, inogona kuramba yakafanana.
y-m-03-09.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nyaya 2 dzakasiyana apo, mushure mekuti shamwari imwe yashandura pfungwa, 'kuverenga kune vakawanda zvakanyanya woga' hazvichashandi. Nhamba ndi kuverenga=1, kudhirowa=2, puzzle=3.

y-m-03-09.s.s2.hint.1: Munhamba itsva, enzanisa rimwe nerimwe kana kuverenga kuri kwakawanda kupfuura zvimwe zviviri zvese.

y-m-03-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Kunyange mushure mekuchinja, kuverenga kuchiri kwakawanda oga. Verenga nhamba zvakare.
y-m-03-09.s.s2.explain: Kana mudzidzi 1 abviswa kubva pakuverenga (kuverenga kuenda pakudhonza: 5, 6, 3 / kuverenga kuenda papuzzle: 5, 5, 4), kana 1 awedzerwa pakudhonza (puzzle kuenda pakudhonza: 6, 6, 2), kuverenga hakusi kwakawanda oga. y-m-03-09.s.s3.r.b: Wakatora musiyano mudiki seuri wakafanana. Vadzidzi 6 nevadzidzi 5 hazvisi nhamba imwechete.

y-m-03-09.s.s3.r.d: Wakataura zvose yakawanda nehukuru hwemusiyano. Mashoko aya akafungawo kuti mhedzisiro yakasimba sei.

y-m-03-08.title: Ndinoshuvira tafura yakadai: kugadzira tafura inosangana nemamiriro

Mamiriro 1: Mudzidzi 1 kana kupfuura akasarudza imwe neimwe yenzvimbo nhatu.
Mamiriro 2: Huwandu hwenzvimbo nhatu ndi vadzidzi 12.
Mamiriro 3: Zoo ine vakawanda kupfuura paki yemitambo, uye paki yemitambo ine vakawanda kupfuura muzinda wemagariro.
Mamiriro 4: Zoo neparki yemitambo hazvisiyani nevadzidzi vanopfuura 2.
